### Key Risks

- **Stronger sedation and impairment:** Combining alcohol with antihistamines can worsen sleepiness, slow reaction times, and impair coordination or judgment—making activities like driving unsafe.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrgEBxCJF12x4wI2zl0WGH70l2euV3TqsWW96h4GvHQ8ym8wecezRZq6U9Ovax4lk81xTDXdF3iaub9ZINyF0zfCX5Fgukxwlch2HxmBIAhRbKTx1aBR_jWfjeCCCFGmLavijY5XU7Oz3m_LCoZ6kEIAe6SX4xnCHNvsACtS0dxs-5xgojYYij3JqyyyaQrGFifJJ5DjEsQGeNBLmcMmZ0K2Ey0Xfv6A07_jN5YJiUkA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF14eRLWpbwVcY40kHHIjrSrqe_i2rZieyjHZ8YgDPqJ_1QillqG1ua0DAi4qZSau79nnSOUhCQ9THsegcxdAt8tdRQSOYK2p2FScCAnOWNBO25aT94QgfOFTZw6XPrS0YKd1dSBAQQmLcCVjMwT2dZJRwRQ9eZpkDtoCoQtpwnV6Q_sFY-O9d_p1WrBxCQObtPoHVLHu9bg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF1-skIDG7QJYjFkoJTPUyTTpV6VYGdlXAxtxAcqnoy1J8jYcYzi4R8mryl-y9crI5W6vg1S74jDojmn_6rlUYNyMGljaLg_t-Nco_Hsdq8vJ6zV_8kv1oeyqrF3hcmiQXv8fdngBSS-2QHbV3ecj7nArN9aUho0svxG4OlefLsxeeEcj5msbRqqosM39-UCoQbPkJ736ZRbNXKnhhYPY2_GVBHHTuFesrsTQ__DFH)
- **First- vs. second-generation antihistamines:** Older, first-generation antihistamines (such as diphenhydramine/Benadryl or chlorpheniramine) cause strong drowsiness on their own and carry higher impairment risks with alcohol. Newer second-generation options (such as loratadine/Claritin, cetirizine/Zyrtec, or fexofenadine/Allegra) are less sedating, though dizziness, fatigue, and alcohol effects can still occur.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF176dy195zsMKJtX13BGQr_FqK0bPG58ezL0hw6umv6pHYJ6FgJk2k73VIOzkUiCiVcnmeIFTi-Cdi9IwcT9shvJKseH7HzhLhbogQd59KOFmcjUWrpEJGxlPG_F8pPZolzrNYkBOghcBq1Kc8h2PBPmJtputMYlKAXlRQMY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15NfPvs7Qhxih6MZuFf82pmmO5L1Kqv-pyH9wFuMLrRfJ4y04LwbYhTOIxV1hUHPenf88fUjPZgzTS-rdndPnFT-nzRYTAF5uVUEMl_T5A7CJWy1wNQ8NS0UQn_XA5gSZxMZzlxw8H9vqCP1HD6Q7EMuTtD8O-wtZj2vzPanFw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXsN0Wm0fkWZLyfwt0KUIt4oqB3S--YPfyYES5AhFkX_HYWLBY2vaO_cO9aWT5vAksJc15PQ4KjnQQVdbRg-z_plsl15_62AfunStZAkrn96WmyFmr6C_lYyFBAUAG9cTy2rWZOmO09XNv3JAF)
- **Combination products:** Multi-symptom allergy, cold, or sinus pills may include decongestants, pain relievers (like acetaminophen or ibuprofen), or sleep aids that add extra liver, stomach, or blood pressure risks with alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1yu-KoKQOeFFevVbVowIrk8hqthvLEC0FE0MR5AJd4AtW6XDbTnaFe-C2BV8oonz-zkZ5uNEG4SXoszjYgWLrCctxER44ezrEeuqFYkvMXX8Ku203buaWIH589edlI9aWdCS0bTztQeVEjeID4x4V9sqkOanV-GgfXco-nr_4zmUuoKmb-qwk7rkgOXLj3bTHHfpbl3VTjko)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrgEBxCJF12x4wI2zl0WGH70l2euV3TqsWW96h4GvHQ8ym8wecezRZq6U9Ovax4lk81xTDXdF3iaub9ZINyF0zfCX5Fgukxwlch2HxmBIAhRbKTx1aBR_jWfjeCCCFGmLavijY5XU7Oz3m_LCoZ6kEIAe6SX4xnCHNvsACtS0dxs-5xgojYYij3JqyyyaQrGFifJJ5DjEsQGeNBLmcMmZ0K2Ey0Xfv6A07_jN5YJiUkA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXj0EqJqexPoXmVMREwdf0O8SQsol5qpYRe75se7kci099m7DnP4cbY3KOqtODYHMCnAIBeT4SN-IQct3dAAB8IRJTSNHnVLdHN-S3_4sL0NVnvSAUn8RmRCHb0_8T17qxPg9jBHmol0i93Qg)
- **Worsened allergy symptoms:** Certain drinks (like beer and wine) can contain histamines or trigger allergy-like flushing and congestion.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF11uJg3kyGTRZ1_vTZ2UD74uxv8jc4ynzKw98FZXxjJJaSlEL2zefTVX2XAljZHAEBtvcPzpiKT-0LciShQ5QLgglR3wkt-q_TOYW7QacWsAAVO3ZIBUbm-yxrbDJXeQ4okCfdJEeVGf1Dur3RfKeaZl9nUWzDYmcAcib8hnaLoyJt80Zef7gH09F6iLDWshAa7z_tEA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15NfPvs7Qhxih6MZuFf82pmmO5L1Kqv-pyH9wFuMLrRfJ4y04LwbYhTOIxV1hUHPenf88fUjPZgzTS-rdndPnFT-nzRYTAF5uVUEMl_T5A7CJWy1wNQ8NS0UQn_XA5gSZxMZzlxw8H9vqCP1HD6Q7EMuTtD8O-wtZj2vzPanFw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXbti8dOHMyXyk2ckjJ8A3wgAjTUQFDU8gGWeyHYGJPDRs5_SQMrOWIrR8-l38SNlR0Z28KvWRQMynX4RDb6ey158A_VOvBDq6yi9iXDDaBAAOtLupkaUpR38Icgi-TJG6IOcEWUWcqA)

- **Avoid mixing:** For more details on timing and differences between antihistamines, see [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF14eRLWpbwVcY40kHHIjrSrqe_i2rZieyjHZ8YgDPqJ_1QillqG1ua0DAi4qZSau79nnSOUhCQ9THsegcxdAt8tdRQSOYK2p2FScCAnOWNBO25aT94QgfOFTZw6XPrS0YKd1dSBAQQmLcCVjMwT2dZJRwRQ9eZpkDtoCoQtpwnV6Q_sFY-O9d_p1WrBxCQObtPoHVLHu9bg).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF14eRLWpbwVcY40kHHIjrSrqe_i2rZieyjHZ8YgDPqJ_1QillqG1ua0DAi4qZSau79nnSOUhCQ9THsegcxdAt8tdRQSOYK2p2FScCAnOWNBO25aT94QgfOFTZw6XPrS0YKd1dSBAQQmLcCVjMwT2dZJRwRQ9eZpkDtoCoQtpwnV6Q_sFY-O9d_p1WrBxCQObtPoHVLHu9bg)
- **Check labels and alternatives:** Read active ingredients carefully, and ask a pharmacist or doctor before combining them. Topical options like saline or steroid nasal sprays act locally rather than sedating the central nervous system.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15NfPvs7Qhxih6MZuFf82pmmO5L1Kqv-pyH9wFuMLrRfJ4y04LwbYhTOIxV1hUHPenf88fUjPZgzTS-rdndPnFT-nzRYTAF5uVUEMl_T5A7CJWy1wNQ8NS0UQn_XA5gSZxMZzlxw8H9vqCP1HD6Q7EMuTtD8O-wtZj2vzPanFw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrgEBxCJF12x4wI2zl0WGH70l2euV3TqsWW96h4GvHQ8ym8wecezRZq6U9Ovax4lk81xTDXdF3iaub9ZINyF0zfCX5Fgukxwlch2HxmBIAhRbKTx1aBR_jWfjeCCCFGmLavijY5XU7Oz3m_LCoZ6kEIAe6SX4xnCHNvsACtS0dxs-5xgojYYij3JqyyyaQrGFifJJ5DjEsQGeNBLmcMmZ0K2Ey0Xfv6A07_jN5YJiUkA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXR8Z_w56kDsUjR81Hx8ygMDzA7XT2ovuIOjTCqVl6vXK6zNP5UWaX2NcM-_KLaHWS2rYQJLlKq-qTuIF22vJH04TH4f6ZHxepiOaCj60X8g7VyBem59DG4mV8emhy8xz_U6BCq5J3cQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF176dy195zsMKJtX13BGQr_FqK0bPG58ezL0hw6umv6pHYJ6FgJk2k73VIOzkUiCiVcnmeIFTi-Cdi9IwcT9shvJKseH7HzhLhbogQd59KOFmcjUWrpEJGxlPG_F8pPZolzrNYkBOghcBq1Kc8h2PBPmJtputMYlKAXlRQMY)
- **Get urgent help if needed:** Seek immediate medical care or contact Poison Help (1-800-222-1222 in the U.S.) if you experience severe dizziness, confusion, trouble breathing, or unusual symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXg8TJBVAJBaZC2qPmhtgYb2jzTr9hFJJq52WWikrhtqC4-slST5xIIFgjtqOy8IuYvUV4ekONMEkC7ss2CNfEaJEYrUZ-Mug5ZpXt2AEQc12YYw3K8ndESMpPZyaOOJL1PQXQvc1YnEAbHTIqXfXy1zCk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15NfPvs7Qhxih6MZuFf82pmmO5L1Kqv-pyH9wFuMLrRfJ4y04LwbYhTOIxV1hUHPenf88fUjPZgzTS-rdndPnFT-nzRYTAF5uVUEMl_T5A7CJWy1wNQ8NS0UQn_XA5gSZxMZzlxw8H9vqCP1HD6Q7EMuTtD8O-wtZj2vzPanFw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESywEBxCJF11TPOdtzEy0_Qiggg8X2C617PBpU95yJ4mVwX45QPjWXqxu3viXYFkfMnpihrk-bROp7lmvLeQK4fgkqduqt6_E4CXFR_uwK1MWmicb_X2t6KdM1WroECIOvon2tXiW74lDqU2nlfMED0Y8KQwHwDPNkis5kKVt23C9cilb8O8zPnI9qCJP4fWTBWvFsqLBbGPjSJ1QwXwjf_BGjCCYfq_AGkyI5xrOW5aVrc-XFCRxri1MqRwsbVSULAdGVVzGteTn76lQqEQ)

items.text: Avoid mixing: For more details on timing and differences between antihistamines, see GoodRx. Check labels and alternatives: Read active ingredients carefully, and ask a pharmacist or doctor before combining them. Topical options like saline or steroid nasal sprays act locally rather than sedating the central nervous system. Get urgent help if needed: Seek immediate medical care or contact Poison Help (1-800-222-1222 in the U.S.) if you experience severe dizziness, confusion, trouble breathing, or unusual symptoms.
